title: Add JSON import and export
goal: Add import and export for canonical worksheet JSON with schema validation on import.
context: JSON is the actual source of truth and should round-trip without losing worksheet content.
acceptance: Imported JSON validates against schema before entering app state
Invalid JSON shows a useful error and does not corrupt current worksheet
Round-trip preserves schema/version metadata and does not export UI-only state
notes: Do not add cloud storage or accounts.
